name: Gift of the Protectors
description: Your Book of Shadows can hold up to max(1, Charisma modifier) willing creatures' names. When a named creature would drop to 0 HP without dying outright, it drops to 1 HP instead. This rescue uses one shared page use per Long Rest, not one per name. A creature writes its own name over one minute; erase a name with a Magic action. No Talisman or Tome free-spell resource is spent.
